name: Attack On Titan
author: hhasanelbadry
description:
It resemble to anime called attack on titan, it's adventure game which talking about player have super tools that help him to jump and move from building to another building and carrying weapon for killing the zombies (small one) and the titan (the huge one) and survive till reach to the flag

The controller of the Player is :

W,A,S,D for movement

Space for Jump

G for shoot

R for aim (zoom in/ out) weapon

scroll with  mouse for change weapon (carbine ,shotgun , pistol) with different ammo

left Click mouse for swinging by pink rope

Right Click mouse for grabbling by black rop

F for thowing knifes "small knifes"

C for crouch

"left ctrl" for sliding

I wish that game have good feedback about you
